Subject: Interest in Redwood — quick questions before demo

Hi Dylan / Ben,

Thanks for the quick response on the signup. We spun up a trial yesterday and I wanted to get a short demo scheduled, but first a few quick context points so we can make the session productive: 

- Use case: real-time invoice parsing + categorization for merchant payouts; will be used to enrich downstream reconciliation. Not a chat UI — mostly batch-ish inference triggered by webhooks but with occasional on-demand scoring for large merchant accounts.
- Expected volume: steady baseline ~50 req/sec, peak bursts up to ~250 req/sec for short windows (~15–30 minutes) during settlement runs. Average payload ~1.5k tokens, some larger batched requests ~8k tokens.
- Timeline: aiming for a pilot in Q4 (approx Nov) and production by end of year if performance checks out.

Couple of asks before demo: any known SSO/SCIM requirements for pilot, and do you have a quick cost ballpark for sustained 100–200 req/s? Also attached is a quick traffic heatmap.

Appreciate it —
Samir
Director, Platform Engineering
AtlasPay

Hi Samir — thanks for the helpful context and for the heatmap. Quick follow-ups so the demo focuses on what matters: 

1) Percentile targets — Do you care more about p50 latency (interactive tooling) or p95/p99 (SLA for settlement windows)? We often tune batching differently depending on the target.
2) Token distribution — is the 8k token size an occasional outlier (e.g., month-end) or a repeating part of the daily workload?
3) Data sensitivity — will any of the payloads include PCI or full card PANs? If so we can cover private deployment options and KMS integration in the call.
4) Pilot scope — for the Q4 pilot, are you planning to run a subset of merchants (e.g., 10%) or the full traffic for a single region?

Proposed times for a 30-minute slot (PST):
- Tue 2026-08-03 09:30–10:00
- Tue 2026-08-03 11:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-08-04 08:00–08:30

If none of those work I can ask Ben to send a couple more options. For cost ballpark I can put together a rough unit cost estimate once you confirm expected concurrency and the percent of long requests (8k tokens).

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

> 2) Token distribution — is the 8k token size an occasional outlier (e.g., month-end) or a repeating part of the daily workload?
> 3) Data sensitivity — will any of the payloads include PCI or full card PANs? If so we can cover private deployment options and KMS integration in the call.
> 4) Pilot scope — for the Q4 pilot, are you planning to run a subset of merchants (e.g., 10%) or the full traffic for a single region?

Hi Dylan — answers inline: 
1) p95 matters more for us — during settlement we need sub-second tail behavior on at least 95% of requests.
2) 8k is mostly month-end / reconciliation batches (2–3 times a month). Day-to-day traffic fits under ~2k tokens.
3) No full PANs — tokenized card ids only. We do store some PII like names and addresses; we'd like to understand retention/audit log options.
4) Pilot scope: plan to run a representative subset (approx 12% of merchants) across US region first.

I've attached a simple spreadsheet with sample daily volumes and a second heatmap. Happy to take the 11:00 slot on Tue (2026-08-03). Could you send a calendar invite?

Thanks,
Samir
